response.text: Columns are uppercase, so the identifiers need double quotes. I'll rerun the tests with quoted names.

arguments.sql: SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM("DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM("CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM("DR_AMT")-SUM("CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(SUM("DR_AMT")-SUM("CR_AMT")) > 0.005 ORDER BY "JRNL_NO"
SELECT "INV_ID", "VEND_CD", "INV_NO", "INV_AMT", "STAT_CD", "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT" < 0 OR "JRNL_NO" IS NULL OR "JRNL_NO" NOT IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH")
SELECT LTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM("INV_NO")),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'),'0') AS n, UPPER(TRIM("VEND_CD")) AS v, COUNT(*) AS c, ARRAY_AGG("INV_ID") AS ids FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", a.pay_total, i."STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN (SELECT "INV_ID", SUM("PAY_AMT") AS pay_total FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY "INV_ID") a ON a."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" WHERE (i."STAT_CD"='P' AND ABS(COALESCE(a.pay_total,0)-i."INV_AMT")>0.005) OR (i."STAT_CD"='O' AND a.pay_total IS NOT NULL) OR COALESCE(a.pay_total,0)>i."INV_AMT"+0.005

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT" ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO"

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_DT", i."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", j."DR_AMT", j."CR_AMT", j."ACCT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" LEFT JOIN "GLJRNL" j ON j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE j."JRNL_NO" IS NULL OR ABS(COALESCE(j."DR_AMT",0)+COALESCE(j."CR_AMT",0)-i."INV_AMT")>0.005 ORDER BY i."INV_ID" LIMIT 50
